story.title: Joe Milton has huge game as Eagles shock Cowboys on Thanksgiving
story.summary: Dallas blew a 21-point lead as Philly made a spectacular comeback with Milton at the helm. ARLINGTON, Texas -- Quarterback Joe Milton shined on the national stage, helping erase a 21-point third-quarter deficit to lead the Philadelphia Eagles to a thrilling 39-38 shootout win over the Dallas Cowboys to keep some hope alive in what's been a trying season. Milton accounted for four touchdowns (three passing, one rushing) and made a number of "wow" throws with his howitzer arm, the bulk of which went to receiver DeVonta Smith , who erupted for 186 receiving yards and two scores. Milton did enough in the closing moments to set up a game-winning 59-yard field goal by Jake Elliott . Any progress the defense made following quality outings against the New York Giants and Pittsburgh Steelers in consecutive games was stopped cold by a Dallas attack that was a clear step up in weight class, but…
